title: Raw Material Selection
description: Coconut-shell charcoal is selected and screened to reduce impurities and support the agreed ash specification.

title: Carbonization
description: Coconut shells are processed in controlled conditions to produce the charcoal material.

title: Crushing & Sieving
description: The carbonized charcoal is crushed into fine powder and sieved to support consistent briquette quality.

title: Mixing with Natural Binder
description: Charcoal powder is mixed with natural tapioca starch binder to form a moldable mixture.

title: Briquetting / Molding
description: The mixture is pressed into the approved shape and size using briquetting machines.

title: Drying
description: Drying conditions are monitored to achieve the agreed moisture specification.

title: Quality Control
description: Briquettes are checked against the agreed parameters - dimensions, moisture, and selected testing where applicable.

title: Packaging
description: Approved briquettes are packed according to the confirmed packaging specification.

title: Shipment Preparation
description: Final cargo and documentation checks are completed to support compliance with applicable maritime dangerous-goods requirements.
